pkgmetadata.longdescription: mcp-server-kibana is a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server exposing Kibana functionality (8.x OpenAPI spec) to AI clients: multi-space support, match_phrase search over data streams with @timestamp-ascending result dumps, and read-only guardrails. Designed to run behind an MCP gateway (mcpproxy) via stdio transport; vendored npm cache installs fully offline at emerge time.
